HOW THIS SITE WORKS

Privacy & terms.

LAST UPDATED / 20 OCTOBER 2026

indiek is an independent music journal. Questions about these practices can be sent to gw@lumejs.com.

Your saved tracks.

When you save a track, its identifier is kept in this browser’s local storage. The list stays on this device and browser; indiek does not send it to an account or a server. It remains until you remove tracks or clear this site’s browser data.

To delete an entry, open Saved and choose Remove beside the track. Remove all entries to empty the list, or use your browser’s site-data controls to clear it entirely. If browser storage is unavailable, saving works only for the current page visit.

Search runs against the journal’s music catalogue in your browser. Search terms are not sent to a search service. The site does not include advertising trackers, account registration or a comment form.

Optional analytics cookies.

Choosing “Allow cookies” enables analytics cookies and visit statistics together. With your permission, indiek uses our Matomo installation at matomo.lumejs.com to understand visits, return visits and how people find and listen to music here. No Matomo script or tracking request is sent before you allow it. Declining does not affect the rest of the site.

Matomo receives the page address and title, visit time, referring domain, and basic browser and request information. IP addresses are masked before being stored in analytics records and used for approximate location. Page query strings, URL fragments and referring-page paths are excluded. A link marked from=threads or from=instagram records only that platform name and the landing page. We also record when an embedded song actually starts, a song is added to Saved, or a page is successfully shared or copied. These events contain the song identifier or page path, not your full saved list. We do not collect search terms or account identifiers, and we do not use session recordings. After consent, first-party Matomo cookies distinguish returning browsers for up to 35 days; a session cookie lasts 30 minutes. Different devices and browsers can be counted separately.

Your analytics choice is stored in this browser for up to 180 days. Use Cookie settings in the footer to change it or withdraw consent. Withdrawal stops further tracking and removes indiek’s analytics cookies; it does not erase already collected records. Earlier permission for cookieless statistics does not enable this version: we ask again, while respecting an earlier refusal. We respect Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control when those browser preferences are enabled. Analytics data is kept on our server for site statistics and is not shared with advertising services. For questions or deletion requests, contact gw@lumejs.com.

YouTube players.

This site uses YouTube API Services through embedded video players. The player and YouTube’s IFrame API script are not loaded until you choose “Agree & play” or “Agree & play all”. That action accepts this privacy notice and these terms for the player, including the YouTube Terms of Service.

Loading a player connects your browser to YouTube. YouTube receives basic information such as your IP address and browser or device information to deliver and secure its player. Playing the video can involve additional information collection, cookies or similar technologies, and advertisements. Details are set out in Google’s Privacy Policy.

Players use YouTube’s privacy-enhanced domain. This reduces certain personalization uses; it does not make the connection anonymous or prevent all data collection. Either “Agree & play” button connects and requests playback in one action. This choice is remembered while you browse in the same page session, so subsequent buttons say “Play”; reloading or leaving the site resets it. Nothing loads again after closing the player until you choose a track. You can play directly from Saved, from an artist page, or with Previous and Next. With Auto-next on, a saved track continues to the next playable track in the displayed order when it ends; playback stops at the end of the list. Play all restarts the first saved track from the beginning and turns Auto-next on. You can turn Auto-next off at any time. If your browser blocks automatic playback, press play in the video to continue.

On mobile, playback starts in a bottom dock and the page scrolls above it. In a short landscape view, the video sits beside the page. Saved and search have their own scrolling lists, separate from the video. Saved keeps your place in the list, with Play all, Previous, Next and Auto-next always within reach. Choosing a song closes the list. For a larger view, use the video’s own fullscreen control. On desktop, the listening window shows your saved tracks alongside the video; Minimize and Expand keep the same video and playback position. The player stays connected while you follow internal links, including browser Back and Forward, in the same tab. Loading another song replaces the current video. Choose Disconnect YouTube or the player’s close button to stop playback and remove the connection, or reload or leave the site. This does not erase information already received by YouTube or clear that service’s cookies. You can also follow the direct YouTube link instead of loading an embedded player.

indiek does not request your Google account details or access private YouTube account data. Video availability can change and may differ by location.

External links and service requests.

Following a link to YouTube, Apple Music or a source publication takes you to a separate service governed by its own terms and privacy policy. indiek does not receive your listening history from those services.

Delivering a web page requires the server to receive request information such as an IP address, browser information and the requested address. Routine access logging is disabled in this site’s Nginx configuration. Error logs may contain request information needed for troubleshooting and are rotated by the hosting configuration. The journal does not combine this information with your saved tracks or search terms.

Messages and corrections.

If you email gw@lumejs.com, your address and message are used to respond and handle your request. Messages may be retained as needed to resolve the request and keep a record of the correction or correspondence. You can ask about or request deletion of that correspondence using the same address; any limits on deletion will be explained in the reply.

Using this journal.

These are independent listening notes, not official artist statements. Music, videos, artist photographs and release artwork remain the property of their respective rights holders. Links and credits do not grant a licence to copy or redistribute that material.

indiek does not host downloadable music or provide a licence to download it. Use the official players and services according to their terms. For corrections, credit changes or content removal requests, contact gw@lumejs.com.

This notice will be updated if the site’s features or data practices change.
